summary: The filing is a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a follow-on public offering of 11,228,700 shares of Class A common stock and 2,225,000 pre-funded warrants by Sidus Space Inc. The public offering price is $4.35 per share (pre-funded warrant price $4.3499). The registrant is the issuer, raising capital via a best-efforts placement with no minimum offering amount, closed on April 21, 2026. This is a routine equity offering, not a special situation. ThinkEquity LLC acts as placement agent. No deal terms are relevant.
